questions.stem:
Two steps read the same value before either writes. What does this program print?

```python
x = 0
a = x
b = x
a = a + 1
b = b + 1
x = a
x = b
print(x)
```
questions.explain: Both copies start at 0 and both become 1. The last assignment x = b stores 1, so one increment is lost.

questions.stem:
What does this program print?

```python
buf = [0] * 4
in_pos = 0
for item in [10, 20, 30, 40, 50]:
    buf[in_pos] = item
    in_pos = (in_pos + 1) % 4
print(buf[0])
```
questions.explain: The first four items fill positions 0 to 3. The fifth item, 50, wraps around and overwrites position 0.

questions.stem:
What does this program print?

```python
turn = 0
steps = 0
while turn != 2:
    turn = turn + 1
    steps = steps + 1
print(steps)
```
questions.explain: The loop stops when turn reaches 2. It takes two passes to get there, so steps is 2.

questions.stem: Which of these is shared by all the threads of one process?
questions.explain: Threads of a process share the code, global data, heap and open files. Each thread has its own stack, registers and program counter.
